issues: Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Updated allergen printouts must be on site at every location, covering the squid tempura and new chicken ramen changes.

Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Squid tempura standard is confirmed as ten pieces with the dynamite sauce served on the side rather than on top, as some London sites had been assembling it incorrectly.

Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Freshest fair promotional materials (ramen vouchers, roller banner and the throw the sandbag game) are not fully distributed across sites, and the items cannot easily be moved between sites.
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Freshest fair ramen vouchers must be inserted into the claw game rather than handed out loose.

Region-wide (North England & Midlands): The Slur delivery app goes live immediately. It shares the Deliveroo driver pool so no new driver registration or tapping in is needed, but it has no paired printer, so tickets must be printed directly from the till.
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): A regional staff incentive has been agreed with Lush, offering four spaces for a free massage experience or DIY workshop.
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Cash up accuracy depends on physical receipts being uploaded to the system, which is where data inaccuracies most often originate.
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Takeaway packaging returns by the end of the month, which will allow bulk ordering of large bags.

Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Site leads are carrying too much administrative workload, so an external supervisor will be recruited in October or November to take some of it on and support scheduling, holidays and workload distribution.
Covers dipped but spend per head rose and the site finished ahead of its sales target.
Delivery performance improved, with fewer contested orders.
Wage cost spiked. Duplicated shifts in Kobas and incorrect clock out times are being investigated and corrected to bring labour back towards target.
A new bartender and server have joined, and Daniel starts on the 14th with training in Birmingham.
The line chef recruitment decision is still outstanding.
A leaking pipe and faulty air conditioning units need attention, and the site is aware of potential asbestos concerns in the building.
Staff have been reminded to remove the service charge when a guest reports a negative experience.
